question.explanationHtml: During the holiday rush, a train ticket entitled the passenger to a ride, but not necessarily a seat.

question.explanationHtml: The cost of the hotel room offset the time savings we gained by taking the train instead of the plane.

question.transcriptHtml: The cost of the hotel room offset the time savings we gained by taking the train instead of the plane.

question.explanationHtml: The train is relatively empty for this time of day.

question.explanationHtml: The Alaskan frontier has train service in the summer, but for the remainder of the year the tracks are impassable.
question.explanationViHtml: Khu vực biên giới Alaska có dịch vụ tàu hỏa vào mùa hè, vào thời gian còn lại của năm, các tuyến đường ray không thể đi lại được.
question.transcriptHtml: The Alaskan frontier has train service in the summer, but for the remainder of the year the tracks are impassable.

question.explanationHtml: I was surprised to find train service to such a remote location.
question.explanationViHtml: Tôi rất ngạc nhiên khi tìm thấy dịch vụ tàu hỏa đến một nơi xa xôi như vậy.
